gdn.title: What is a GDN License?
gdn.intro: A GDN (General Distinguishing Number) license is the license issued by the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles that allows you to legally buy and sell used vehicles as a dealer in Texas. Without it, you cannot legally operate a dealership. [ Additional intro copy to be provided by client ]
gdn.whyTitle: Why work with Dealer License Pros?
gdn.whyBody: Navigating the GDN process alone is time-consuming and easy to get wrong. A single deficiency can set you back months. We've guided hundreds of dealers through the process without a single unnecessary delay — and we're the only company in Texas that does it in person.

landing.headline: Stop Googling. Start Your Dealership the Right Way.

landing.body1: We don't just give you information—we guide you through every step of getting your dealer license, so you can launch faster and avoid costly mistakes.
